question: Which of the following is the state flower of Manipur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shirui Lily**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Shirui Lily is a rare Indian species of plant **found only in the upper reaches of the Shirui hill ranges in the Ukhrul district of Manipur, India.
 
• It is a seasonal flowering plant and at its best in **May and June when it blooms.**
 
• **Manipur**__
